kept.step.says: Keeping the saved answers current after one step.

kept.step.scoped.says: Finding the part of the pod a step touched.

kept.step.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files that part holds.

kept.step.namedbefore.says: Finding what the touched records were called before the step.

kept.step.reached.says: Finding every record the step's changes reach.

kept.step.closed.says: Widening the touched part until nothing else depends on it.

kept.step.rebuilt.says: Re-deriving the answers for the touched part.

kept.reached.judged.says: Finding what the judgment files a step wrote refer to.

kept.rebuilt.filesof.says: Finding the files of the records being re-derived.

kept.rebuilt.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files of the records being re-derived.

kept.rebuilt.derive.says: Re-deriving the answers for the re-derived records.

kept.rebuilt.held.says: Setting aside the answers that stay as they were.

kept.whole.says: Keeping the saved answers current by re-deriving all of them.

kept.whole.derive.says: Deriving every answer from every record.

kept.whole.recordsandtheirs.says: Gathering every record with what belongs to it.

kept.scoped.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files of just the part being kept current.

build.queried.says: Building the pod's answer files by running each of the pod's questions over its facts.

build.queried.currentversions.says: Picking the current version of each record.

build.queried.viewsheld.says: Working out which answer files the pod's records call for.

build.queried.written.says: Writing the answer files that changed.

incremental.boundvalues.says: Narrowing a question to only the records that changed.
